      Germany, and China $67B from 2008–2020, and solar prices

      will be 20–30% higher in 2030 if countries move to produce domestically.

    </p>

    <div class="finding-source">

      <i>Nature</i> · 2022

    </div>

  </a>

  <a class="finding-card"

    <div class="finding-category">

      Climate and Public Health

    </div>

    <div class="finding-number">

      595 Avoided Deaths

    </div>

    <h3>Imported Solar Panels Deliver Major Benefits</h3>

    <p>

      Imported solar PVs contributed to 178 million tonnes of avoided

      CO₂ emissions and 595 avoided premature deaths in the United States,

      generating an estimated $28 billion in climate and health benefits.

    </p>

    <div class="finding-source">

      <i>One Earth</i> · 2025

    </div>

  </a>

  <a class="finding-card"

    </div>

    <div class="finding-number">

      11% Cheaper

    </div>

    <h3>Renewable Pathway Is Cost-Effective</h3>

    <p>

      Rapid cost reductions in renewable energy and storage technologies

      reshaped the energy transition landscape, showing that a

      renewable-dominant pathway is both technologically sound

      and cost-effective.

    </p>

    <div class="finding-source">

      <i>Nature Communications</i> · 2020

    </div>

  </a>

</div>
